title: Uniform all-sheet Olver Bessel-K asymptotic expansions for even analytic disk perturbations with strictly positive real part of the exponent
author: Hans Volkmer
source_title: The Asymptotic Expansion of Kummer Functions for Large Values of the a-Parameter, and Remarks on a Paper by Olver
difficulty_reason: The proof continues the K-type solution around arbitrarily many sheets using its monodromy coefficient and the normalized Floquet I-type solution. It recombines four error contributions through a Bessel Wronskian into the continued K basis, and controls the loss of two powers of the large parameter by starting one order further. This gives an all-sheet remainder bound beyond formal analytic continuation of an asymptotic series.
source_version: Official SIGMA 12 (2016) article 046, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2016.046; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete interior Re(mu)>0 proof of4.1 and required3.1-3.2 read. Frobenius decomposition identifies W1 with W+, and its scalar normalization is flat to every algebraic order; the exact W2 monodromy coefficient beta(u)=pi*i+O(u^-2N) normalizes W4. Formula4.2, the explicit G1-G4/H1-H4 recombination via the Bessel Wronskian, product bounds and N+1-to-N error-order recovery prove the unrestricted-argument bound. Prior Olver disk-sector expansions and standard Bessel continuation/product estimates are cited background. The excluded boundary Re(mu)=0 part of Lemma3.1 literally prints z=r exp(plus/minus i*r) while asserting z^(2mu) tends to zero; no boundary claim or corrected spiral is supplied. No complex-u, negative-mu or Kummer-specialization neighbor is counted.

statement_scope: Only the Re(mu)>0 portion of author4.1. f even analytic on disk |z|<R0, fixed0<R<R0; w solves w_second=(1/z)w_first+(u^2+(mu^2-1)/z^2+f(z))w. A0=1, A_s(0)=0 for s>=1 and recursive coefficients2.2-2.3. The source Olver W2 admits exact Bessel-K expansion2.7 with |g2|+|h2|<=K_N u^(-2N) for u>=u_N,0<|z|<=R, on the full logarithm Riemann surface without an argument restriction. Boundary Re(mu)=0, complex-u and special-function identification are outside scope.
